newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Office Products closes acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Office Products closes acquisitions.

text.p: U.S. Office Products Co said Wednesday it had completed the acquisition of 13 companies ranging from travel services to office supplies in deals worth a total of $149.9 million.
The company said the combined value of the deals consisted of $148.1 million in U.S. Office common stock and $1.8 million in cash.
The acquired companies had annualized revenues totalling about $343 million, it added.
U.S. Office said the acquisitions brought its third quarter acquisition to 25 companies with more than $570 million in annualized revenues.
SFI Corp and Professional Travel Corp were among the latest acquisitions, it said.
U.S. Office operates throughout the United States, as well as in New Zealand, Australia, Canada and the United Kingdom, selling office and educational products and services.
